text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, No Reason-chan! Have a 
wonderful birthday~.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Mirako! I am delighted! I am in your 
debt.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
However... how about one more try! What 
would it sound like if I gave a blessing 
my way?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh. What's that about... Uhhh? Should I 
celebrate in a way that feels like No 
Reason?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nya-ha-ha~! Splendid, truly splendid~ 
Let's hear another cheer!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Whoa-ooh?! ...All right~! ...Oh, hearty 
congratulations to ya~!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mirako. In that case, the proper phrasing 
is 'how auspicious'.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha! My bad, my bad! 'Twas merely 
jesting, of course!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Thou truly hast the most delightful 
reactions. Thou hast given me a truly 
amusing gift indeed!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, my reaction counts as a birthday 
present?! That's kind of... embarrassing~ 
hehehe~."
